memory_candidates.content: For metatasks that produce new tasks (not code), the plan phases should group task creation by dependency wave: independent tasks first, then tasks that depend on each other or on existing tasks. The implementation phase uses state.json jq updates directly. Keep task descriptions self-contained with explicit file paths, dependency task numbers, and effort estimates so implementers can start without re-reading the gap analysis. After state.json updates, always regenerate TODO.md with bash .claude/scripts/generate-todo.sh.
